description:
Design a functional outdoor kitchen and dining area in the backyard of the sample house using NCH DreamPlan Home Design Software.

Your goal is to:
1. Navigate to the backyard/patio area.
2. Add a Barbecue Grill (from the Exterior/Outdoor furniture library).
3. Add a Prep Table or Outdoor Counter near the grill.
4. Add an Outdoor Dining Table and at least 4 Chairs in the patio area.
5. Arrange them logically so there is space to walk between the cooking and dining zones.
6. Save a screenshot of your 3D design to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\outdoor_kitchen_design.png'.
7. Save the project to preserve your changes.
